Sectors

We know your industry. Usually painfully well.

Every sector has its own pressures, language and politics. Our programmes are designed to speak directly to the realities of your working environment, with examples and exercises from your world.

Tell us your challenge

Charity

4 case studies

Charities and non-profit organisations operate with a unique combination of passion and constraint. Teams are deeply committed to their cause, but often work with limited resources and face complex stakeholder landscapes that include donors, trustees, beneficiaries, and regulators. ITD helps charity professionals develop the leadership, communication, and influencing skills that enable them to amplify their organisation's impact and sustain their own wellbeing.

Explore

Financial Services

3 case studies

The financial services sector demands exceptional interpersonal skills. Whether your teams are managing client portfolios, navigating regulatory conversations, or leading through periods of rapid change, the ability to communicate with clarity and confidence is critical. ITD has extensive experience working with banks, insurers, asset managers, and fintech firms to develop the soft skills that underpin commercial success and regulatory credibility.

Explore

Law Firms

19 case studies

In an increasingly competitive legal market, technical legal expertise is table stakes. The firms that thrive are those whose lawyers can build deep client relationships, lead high-performing teams, and present their advice with clarity and conviction. ITD has extensive experience working with law firms of all sizes, from global practices to specialist boutiques, developing the soft skills that complement legal excellence and drive commercial growth.

Explore

Local Government

3 case studies

Local government organisations serve some of the most diverse communities in the country, and their staff need outstanding interpersonal skills to manage competing demands, deliver services effectively, and engage meaningfully with elected members and residents alike. ITD has a strong track record of supporting councils and public-sector bodies with training that develops confident, capable leaders and communicators at every level.

Explore

Manufacturing

Manufacturing organisations succeed when their people work together effectively, communicate clearly, and take ownership of quality and continuous improvement. ITD partners with manufacturers across a wide range of sub-sectors to develop the leadership and interpersonal skills that translate directly into better operational performance. From team leaders on the production line to senior operations directors, we help manufacturing professionals become more confident and capable communicators and leaders.

Explore

Maritime

The maritime industry is a global, safety-critical sector where clear communication and effective leadership can be the difference between a routine operation and a serious incident. ITD works with shipping companies, port authorities, classification societies, and maritime service providers to develop the interpersonal skills that support safe operations, strong team performance, and effective stakeholder management. Our programmes are designed to address the unique challenges of leading and communicating in a maritime environment.

Explore

Media

1 case study

The media industry thrives on creativity, speed, and the ability to tell compelling stories. Behind every successful campaign, broadcast, or publication is a team of people who need to collaborate under pressure, manage demanding clients, and lead creative talent effectively. ITD works with media organisations including broadcasters, publishers, advertising agencies, and digital media companies to develop the interpersonal skills that enable creative teams to do their best work and deliver outstanding results for clients.

Explore

Pharma / Biotech

The pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries are driven by scientific excellence, but commercial success depends equally on the ability to communicate, influence, and lead. From presenting clinical trial data to regulators, to managing cross-functional drug development teams, to engaging with healthcare professionals and payers, soft skills play a critical role at every stage of the product lifecycle. ITD has deep experience supporting pharma and biotech organisations with training that helps scientific professionals become confident, compelling communicators and leaders.

Explore

Schools

Schools are dynamic, demanding workplaces where effective communication and strong leadership have a direct impact on student outcomes. ITD works with primary and secondary schools, academy trusts, and independent schools to develop the soft skills of teachers, senior leaders, and support staff. Our programmes are designed to be practical, time-efficient, and directly relevant to the challenges that school professionals face every day.

Explore

Technology

The technology sector moves at extraordinary pace, and the ability to communicate clearly, influence stakeholders, and lead diverse teams has never been more important. ITD works with technology companies ranging from early-stage start-ups to global enterprises, developing the soft skills that turn brilliant technologists into effective leaders and communicators. Our programmes bridge the gap between technical expertise and the interpersonal capabilities that drive commercial success.

Explore

Travel

The travel industry is built on people and experiences. Whether your teams are managing complex itineraries, handling customer complaints, or leading operations across multiple time zones, outstanding interpersonal skills are essential. ITD works with travel companies including tour operators, airlines, hospitality groups, and travel management companies to develop the communication, leadership, and customer service skills that drive customer loyalty and operational excellence.

Explore

Universities

Universities are complex organisations where academic excellence, research ambition, and student experience must all be supported by effective leadership and communication. ITD works with universities across the UK and internationally to develop the soft skills of academic staff, professional services teams, and senior leaders. Our training helps university professionals navigate the unique challenges of higher education while building the collaborative culture that underpins institutional success.

Explore

Utilities

Utility companies play a vital role in the infrastructure of everyday life, and the people who manage and operate these organisations face a distinctive set of challenges. From engaging with regulators and local communities to driving safety culture across dispersed field teams, strong interpersonal skills are essential. ITD works with energy, water, and infrastructure organisations to develop leaders and teams who communicate effectively and drive positive change.
